description: Motra for ChatGPT gives you a personal fitness analyst that understands your entire training history. Just ask about your workouts and get instant insights. Ask how your bench press has progressed, what your total volume was this month, or which muscle groups you've been neglecting. Track personal records, explore exercise history set by set, and discover patterns in your training. Whether you're planning your next session, reviewing your week, or chasing a new PR — get the answers you need just by asking.
